- Complete the Portuguese-language Boxing Legacy game into a playable game and verify it runs.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save check screenshots as JPEGs no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Use `resolveRoundScore()` for consistent round transitions, judge scoring, recovery, and round advancement.

- Keep opponent division aligned with the player’s selected division.

### Completed
- Updated fight setup and reset handling, including phase, winner, guard timer, and attack cooldown.
- Replaced duplicated round-timer logic in `updateFight()` with `resolveRoundScore()`.
- Improved punching, guard, dodge, clinch, stamina, and blocked-hit behavior.
- Added opponent scoring for landed attacks, knockout messaging, and career progression changes.
- Updated opponent generation to match the player’s division.
- Ran `node --check app.js` successfully before the latest round of code changes.

- Fix and verify remaining combat/progression issues: opponent guard timer expiration; correct player and opponent score handling at final-round timeout; mobile D-pad key mapping; training affordability.
- Re-run syntax validation and verify career/fight progression in a browser.
- Save and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, at most 1280px wide.

- (none)

1. Decrement opponent `guardTimer` over time and expire the guard; currently `aiAttack()` sets the timer but it is not decremented.

- `app.js`: Game state, career systems, combat, AI, rendering, training, and event handlers.
- `index.html`: Game screens and fight arena/control markup.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.

- `app.js` has uncommitted changes; browser verification and screenshot capture have not been completed.

## Objective
- Complete the Portuguese-language Boxing Legacy game into a playable game and verify it runs.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save check screenshots as JPEGs no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use `resolveRoundScore()` for consistent round transitions, judge scoring, recovery, and round advancement.
- Award tied rounds 10–10; score opponent punches that land and distinguish knockouts from decisions.
- Keep opponent division aligned with the player’s selected division.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated fight setup and reset handling, combat and AI, career progression, opponent generation, round scoring, opponent guard expiration, and final-round timeout handling in `app.js`.
- Added mobile D-pad arrow-key mapping and prevented training when the player cannot afford the $80 fee.
- Browser checks confirmed starting a fight, movement, punches, affordable training charges $80, and unaffordable training does not charge cash.
- Fixed health/stamina bar updates in `updateFightHud()` to use current fight values, including zero.
- Latest `node --check app.js` and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Verify health/stamina bars during live combat and after a KO.
- Test round transitions and final decision scoring without reloading during a fight.
- Restore clean browser save state, verify career/progression state, capture a compliant JPEG screenshot, and inspect only that newest screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use the running browser at `http://localhost:3002` to verify HUD updates, round transitions, and final decision scoring in a live fight.
2. Restore clean local storage state and check career/progression.
3. Capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px), then report results and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Game logic, scoring, training, HUD rendering, and uncommitted changes.
- `index.html`: Game screens and fight/training controls.
- `styles.css`: Visual design and responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- Browser local storage key `boxing-legacy-save-v1` was left in a zero-cash test state.
- Reloading during a fight resets it through `ensureFightSetup()`, so live round/scoring tests must avoid reloading.
- A previous fight test ended in a player KO before the player could land punches; combat balance may need review.
- Changes are uncommitted; `app.js` is modified.
